description: This file defines API endpoints for managing models in a proxy server, including adding, updating, deleting models, and managing model groups and links. It contains route handlers, utility functions, and classes related to model management within a FastAPI application.

classes.name: UpdatePublicModelGroupsRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating public model groups

classes.name: ModelManagementAuthChecks
classes.description: Contains static methods for authorization checks related to model management, including user permissions and team access control.

methods.name: get_db_model
methods.description: Fetches a model from the database by model_id and returns a Deployment object if found.

methods.name: update_db_model
methods.description: Merges updates into an existing Deployment object and converts it into a Prisma-compatible update format.

methods.name: patch_model
methods.description: PATCH endpoint to update model details in the database, with authorization and cache clearing.

methods.name: _add_model_to_db
methods.description: Adds a new model record to the database, encrypting sensitive parameters.

methods.name: _add_team_model_to_db
methods.description: Creates a team-specific model with a unique name, updates team alias mappings, and adds the model to the team.

methods.name: _update_team_model_in_db
methods.description: Handles updates to team models, managing alias creation or updates based on team assignment changes.

methods.name: _get_public_model_name
methods.description: Determines the public model name based on patch data or existing model info.

methods.name: _setup_new_team_model_assignment
methods.description: Sets up a new team model with a unique name and updates team alias mappings.

methods.name: _update_existing_team_model_assignment
methods.description: Updates an existing team model alias if the public name has changed.

methods.name: can_user_make_team_model_call
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to perform actions on team models, including premium and admin checks.

methods.name: allow_team_model_action
methods.description: Verifies if a user can perform team model actions, including team existence and premium status.

methods.name: can_user_make_model_call
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to make model calls, considering team and role restrictions.

methods.name: delete_model
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a model, remove aliases, update team info, and delete from database and router.

methods.name: delete_team_model_alias
methods.description: Removes a model alias from all team mappings and returns the list of removed aliases.

methods.name: add_new_model
methods.description: Endpoint to add a new model, store it in the database, and optionally notify via Slack.

methods.name: update_public_model_groups
methods.description: Updates the list of publicly accessible model groups in the configuration.

methods.name: update_useful_links
methods.description: Updates the list of useful links in the configuration.

methods.name: clear_cache
methods.description: Clears cached models from the router and reloads models from the database, preserving config models.
